title: Phone and video calls
intro: Calls are harder than face-to-face: no body language and bad connections. Learn the fixed phrases for opening, holding, leaving messages, fixing tech problems and checking details.
introBn: ফোন ও ভিডিও কলে শরীরী ভাষা থাকে না, লাইনও খারাপ হয়। কল শুরু, অপেক্ষা, মেসেজ, সমস্যা আর তথ্য যাচাইয়ের বাক্য শিখুন।

units.title: Opening, holding and leaving messages
units.idea: On the phone, say who you are with 'This is…', ask for people with 'Could I speak to…?', ask callers to hold, and leave clear messages with your name, number and reason.
units.ideaBn: ফোনে নিজের পরিচয় দিতে This is…, কাউকে চাইতে Could I speak to…?, অপেক্ষা করাতে hold on, আর মেসেজে নাম, নম্বর ও কারণ বলুন।

formula.name: Open
formula.pos: Hello, this is Rafi from Nexa Solutions. · Could I speak to Ms Khan, please?

formula.name: Hold
formula.pos: Could you hold on a moment? · I'll put you through. · Sorry to keep you waiting.

formula.name: Message
formula.pos: Can I take a message? · Could you ask her to call me back? · My number is 01711 234 567.

uses.rule: Say 'This is…' or 'It's…' on the phone, not 'I am…'.
uses.bn: ফোনে I am নয়, This is…।
uses.ex: Hi, this is Rafi calling from Dhaka.

uses.rule: Ask for someone with 'Could I speak to…?'
uses.bn: কাউকে চাইতে Could I speak to…?
uses.ex: Could I speak to someone in Accounts, please?

uses.rule: Hold on / put through / call back are phrasal verbs.
uses.bn: hold on, put through, call back।
uses.ex: Hold on, I'll put you through to her.

uses.rule: Leave a message: name, reason, number, best time.
uses.ex: It's Rafi about the invoice. Please call me on 01711 234 567 after 2.
Thanks for your help. Bye for now.

traps.why: On the phone we say 'This is'.

traps.wrong: Please hold the line, I am transferring.
traps.right: Please hold on, I'll put you through.

traps.wrong: Tell him to call me back to me.
traps.right: Could you ask him to call me back?

drills.s: Good morning, ___ Rafi from Nexa Solutions.
Could I ___ to Mr Chowdhury, please?
One moment, I'll put you ___ to the manager.
I'm afraid she's in a meeting. Can I ___ a message?

drills.q: একটু অপেক্ষা করবেন? আমি দেখে নিচ্ছি।
o: Could you hold on a moment? I'll just check.
Please wait little, I am seeing.
Can you hold a moment I check?
Could you hold on a moment? I'll just checking.
drills.a: Could you hold on a moment? I'll just check.

o: Hello, it's me, you know my number.
Hi, it's Rafi from Nexa about the delivery date. Could you call me back on 01711 234 567? Thanks.
Why you are not picking up?
drills.a: Hi, it's Rafi from Nexa about the delivery date. Could you call me back on 01711 234 567? Thanks.

drills.s: Could you ask him to call me ___ this afternoon?

units.title: Video calls, connection problems and checking details
units.idea: Online calls go wrong: the line breaks up, someone is on mute, the screen freezes. Name the problem politely, check you understood, and spell names and numbers clearly.
units.ideaBn: অনলাইন কলে লাইন কেটে যায়, কেউ মিউটে থাকে। ভদ্রভাবে সমস্যা বলুন, বুঝেছেন কিনা যাচাই করুন, আর নাম ও নম্বর স্পষ্ট করে বানান করুন।

formula.name: Problems
formula.pos: You're breaking up. · You're on mute. · Your screen has frozen. · Can you hear me OK?

formula.name: Check
formula.pos: Sorry, could you say that again? · Just to confirm, you said Tuesday? · So what you mean is…

formula.name: Spell
formula.pos: That's R-A-F-I. · B for Bravo. · Double O. · Oh-one-seven-one-one.

uses.ex: Sorry, you're breaking up. I'll call you back.
I think you're on mute, Mr Tan.
Just to confirm, the deadline is the 15th, right?

uses.rule: Read phone numbers in groups; say 'double' and 'oh'.
uses.bn: নম্বর ভাগ করে বলুন; double, oh।
uses.ex: Zero one seven one one, double two, three four.

uses.rule: Spell with code words to avoid mistakes.
uses.ex: H for Hotel, A for Alpha, S for Sierra, A, N.

traps.right: Could you say that again, please?
Does that make sense? / Is that clear?
traps.why: Direct 'Did you understand?' can sound like a teacher.

drills.s: Sorry, Mr Tan, you're ___ up. Could you repeat that?

drills.q: Client is talking but you hear nothing.

o: Sorry, could you say that again?
drills.a: Sorry, could you say that again?

drills.s: Just ___ confirm, the call is at 3 pm Dhaka time?

drills.q: Pick the clearest way to say 01722 334 455.
o: Zero one seven double two, double three, double four, double five.
Zero one seven two two three three four four five five.
drills.a: Zero one seven double two, double three, double four, double five.

drills.s: So that's the plan. Does that make ___?
Sorry, can you ___ me OK? The line is bad.

mastery.s: Hold on, please. I'll put you ___.

o: You're breaking up. Shall I call you back?
mastery.a: You're breaking up. Shall I call you back?

mastery.s: Could you ask her to call me ___?
